_comment: Where each asset stands. type = a key of asset_types.json. position = [x, y] or [x, y, z] in metres; orientation_deg = [roll, pitch, yaw] (or yaw_deg) - only yaw turns the footprint and approach side; scale = number or [sx, sy, sz]. Optional per asset: approach_side, usd (overrides the type), readings {name: {normal_low: .., normal_high: ..}} and primary. Copy to ~/.physical_ai_fleet/asset_layout.json (or set FLEET_ASSET_LAYOUT); SAVE LAYOUT in the Assets panel writes there.
